chunks.head: in the course of
chunks.note: 表示某事在另一件事进行的过程中发生。course 此处意为“进程、过程”，非“课程”。
chunks.ex_en: In the course of the meeting, several new ideas came up.
chunks.ex_cn: 在会议过程中，冒出了好几个新点子。

chunks.head: run off
chunks.note: 指(偷偷地)离开、逃跑。本章指汤姆离家出走当海盗。
chunks.ex_en: The puppy ran off before I could catch it.
chunks.ex_cn: 我还没抓住，小狗就跑掉了。

chunks.head: care for
chunks.note: 本章意为“关心、在乎某人”；另有“照顾”和“喜欢”义。
chunks.ex_en: I know you care for your little sister very much.
chunks.ex_cn: 我知道你很关心你的小妹妹。

chunks.head: look back
chunks.note: 常接 on/at，表示回想过去的经历。
chunks.ex_en: When you grow up, you'll look back on these days and smile.
chunks.ex_cn: 长大后，你会回想起这些日子而会心一笑。

chunks.head: better than nothing
chunks.gloss: 聊胜于无；有总比没有强
chunks.note: 用于说某事虽不理想，但仍胜过完全没有。
chunks.ex_en: It's just a small gift, but it's better than nothing.
chunks.ex_cn: 只是个小礼物，但聊胜于无。

chunks.head: go on
chunks.gloss: 继续；(催促对方)接着说、往下讲
chunks.note: 本章反复用作催促“接着说”；也泛指“继续(做某事)”。
chunks.ex_en: Please go on—I want to hear the rest of the story.
chunks.ex_cn: 请接着说，我想听故事的其余部分。

chunks.head: better off
chunks.note: 指钱财、健康或整体处境更好。反义为 worse off。
chunks.ex_en: He felt he would be better off living in a smaller town.
chunks.ex_cn: 他觉得住在小一点的镇子上日子会更好过。

chunks.head: shut someone up
chunks.gloss: 让某人闭嘴；使某人住口
chunks.note: shut up 作不及物是“住口”；及物 shut sb up 即“让某人闭嘴”。
chunks.ex_en: Nothing could shut him up once he started talking.
chunks.ex_cn: 他一旦开口，什么都没法让他闭嘴。

chunks.head: call on
chunks.note: call on sb = 短暂地拜访某人；另有“号召、请某人发言”义。
chunks.ex_en: We plan to call on our grandparents this weekend.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个周末我们打算去看望祖父母。

chunks.head: would give anything
chunks.note: 常接 to do 或 for sth，表示极度渴望某事。
chunks.ex_en: I would give anything to see that concert.
chunks.ex_cn: 我愿付出一切去看那场演唱会。

chunks.head: part with
chunks.note: part with sth = 不舍地交出或放弃某物。
chunks.ex_en: She could not bear to part with her old teddy bear.
chunks.ex_cn: 她舍不得丢掉她那只旧泰迪熊。

chunks.head: make up
chunks.note: 本章意为“和解”；make up 另有“编造、化妆、组成”等义。
chunks.ex_en: The two friends quarreled but soon made up.
chunks.ex_cn: 两个朋友吵了架，但很快就和好了。

chunks.head: back and forth
chunks.note: 表示在两处之间反复移动。
chunks.ex_en: The children ran back and forth across the yard.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里来回奔跑。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 本章意为“立刻”；at once 另有“同时”一义。
chunks.ex_en: Come here at once—we're leaving now!
chunks.ex_cn: 马上过来，我们现在就走！

chunks.head: and so on
chunks.note: 用于列举之后，表示同类事物还有很多。
chunks.ex_en: She packed clothes, books, toys, and so on.
chunks.ex_cn: 她收拾了衣服、书、玩具等等。

chunks.head: throw away
chunks.gloss: 白白错过；扔掉；浪费(机会)
chunks.note: 本章指“白白放弃(机会)”；也指把东西扔掉。
chunks.ex_en: Don't throw away this chance to study abroad.
chunks.ex_cn: 别白白放弃这次出国留学的机会。

chunks.head: can't help it
chunks.gloss: 忍不住；控制不住；没办法
chunks.note: can't help + it / doing = 情不自禁、无法克制。help 此处意为“抑制、避免”。

literal.note_cn: 此处为 can 的过去式
此处意为“抑制、避免”，非“帮助”

chunks.ex_en: I know I shouldn't laugh, but I can't help it.
chunks.ex_cn: 我知道不该笑，可我忍不住。

chunks.head: attend to
chunks.note: attend to sth/sb = 处理某事或照料某人。注意与 attend(出席)区分。
chunks.ex_en: The nurse has many patients to attend to.
chunks.ex_cn: 护士有许多病人要照料。

chunks.head: in vain
chunks.note: vain 此处意为“徒劳的”，非“虚荣”。in vain 常置于句首或句尾。
chunks.ex_en: They searched all night, but in vain.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们找了一整夜，却是徒劳。

chunks.head: get rid of
chunks.note: get rid of sb/sth = 甩掉、清除掉某人或某物。
chunks.ex_en: It's hard to get rid of a bad habit.
chunks.ex_cn: 坏习惯很难改掉。

chunks.head: go through the motions
chunks.gloss: 走过场；例行公事；敷衍了事
chunks.note: 指只做表面动作而无真心投入。motions 指“动作”。本章指汤姆对着空气做出打人的动作。
chunks.ex_en: He wasn't really trying—just going through the motions.
chunks.ex_cn: 他并没真下功夫，只是走走过场。

chunks.head: burst into tears
chunks.note: burst into + tears / laughter / song = 突然爆发出(某种情绪或声音)。
chunks.ex_en: The little boy burst into tears when he lost his balloon.
chunks.ex_cn: 小男孩弄丢气球时突然大哭起来。

chunks.head: leave someone alone
chunks.gloss: 别打扰某人；让某人独自待着
chunks.note: leave sb alone = 不去打扰、别烦某人。
chunks.ex_en: I'm tired—please leave me alone for a while.
chunks.ex_cn: 我累了，请让我一个人待一会儿。

chunks.head: change one's mind
chunks.note: 指做出与原先不同的决定。
chunks.ex_en: She wanted to go, but then changed her mind.
chunks.ex_cn: 她本想去，后来又改了主意。

chunks.head: lose patience
chunks.note: 常接 with sb，表示对某人失去耐心。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher lost patience with the noisy class.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师对吵闹的班级失去了耐心。

chunks.head: into the bargain
chunks.note: 多置于句末，表示“除此之外还…”。与买卖 bargain 无关，是固定习语。

literal.note_cn: 此处为固定习语，非“便宜货”

chunks.ex_en: The hotel was cheap, and had a great view into the bargain.
chunks.ex_cn: 这家旅馆便宜，而且还带着极好的景致。

chunks.head: make much of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式“made so much of him”，故 card-only。make much of sb = 对某人格外看重、宠爱。
chunks.ex_en: The whole family made much of the new baby.
chunks.ex_cn: 全家人都对新生儿宠爱有加。
